name: Demetrius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Demetrius the silversmith made shrines for Diana and stirred up the craftsmen because Paul had persuaded much people that they be no gods which are made with hands, endangering both their wealth and the temple of the great goddess whom all Asia worshipped.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Demetrius and the silversmiths of Ephesus
cases.charge: Raising an uproar over lost trade under the colour of zeal for Diana
